scenes.title: The Field Trip

lines.t:
CHAPTER 2
The Jungle and the Cave
Tomorrow, the first-years will visit the jungle reserve for a field picnic and survival exercise.
Each of you will wear one of these tracking watches. Do not remove them. The jungle is not a playground.
A picnic! In the jungle! Peter, we're sitting together. I'm bringing three kinds of sandwiches.
Three?
One for me, one for you, one for emergencies.

scenes.hint: Sleep at home to end the day. Something will be announced at school tomorrow.

scenes.title: The Cave

lines.t: The jungle reserve. Sunlight through giant leaves. Students sprawl across blankets while the crews claim the shade.
Emergency sandwich?
Hold that thought. I'll be back in a minute — I want to look around.
Don't get lost. Your watch beeps if you go too far.
One minute. Promise.
The path narrows. The sounds of the picnic fade. Something pulls Peter forward — like a word on the tip of his tongue.
A cave mouth, half-hidden by roots. Carved symbols around its edge. They look… older than Nexa.
This isn't on any map I've studied.
Inside: dozens of stone statues. Warriors, beasts, things with too many arms. All facing a sealed door covered in light-lines.
An ancient structure rises at the centre. The air hums.
What is this place…?
Behind him, the entrance grinds shut.
No — no, no, no!
Stone cracks. One by one, the statues turn their heads.
And begin to move.
There were too many. Peter fought anyway — until the stone fists stopped feeling like pain and started feeling like nothing at all.
Somewhere far away, a watch beeps. And beeps. And beeps.
Parker's signal is off the trail! Over here — the ruins!
The teachers tear through the sealed entrance. They find Peter on the stone floor, barely breathing. The statues stand perfectly still, as if they never moved.
Peter! PETER! You said one minute!
He is carried out of the jungle and rushed to Nexa Central Hospital.

scenes.hint: Rest. The jungle picnic is tomorrow.
